title: The 5 Farthest Human-Made Objects, Ranked (#1 Is Almost a Light-Day Away)

scenes.text: The farthest thing humans ever built is almost a full light-day from home.

scenes.label: New Horizons · ~63 AU
scenes.text: Number five: New Horizons. About six billion miles out, still flying and past Pluto since twenty fifteen.

scenes.label: Pioneer 11 · ~117 AU
scenes.text: Number four: Pioneer eleven. About eleven billion miles away, and silent since nineteen ninety-five.

scenes.label: Pioneer 10 · ~140 AU
scenes.text: Number three: Pioneer ten. About thirteen billion miles, silent since two thousand three. A dead probe, still drifting outward.

scenes.label: Voyager 2 · ~141 AU
scenes.text: Number two: Voyager two. About thirteen billion miles, still sending data, and only a hair ahead of Pioneer ten.

scenes.label: Voyager 1 · ~169 AU
scenes.text: Number one: Voyager one. More than fifteen billion miles. Its signal takes almost a full day to reach us.

description:
The five farthest human-made objects, ranked by distance from the Sun.
Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and is still talking to us from more than fifteen billion miles away.
What should we send out there next?
first_comment: Did you know Pioneer 10 is still out there? Which record should we rank next?
